title: BackendDefinition
description: A terminal backend version: an SSH worker image implementing managed-ssh-v2, its resources, limits and mount slots.

image.description: The SSH worker image terminal environments run, pinned by digest. A tag is not accepted.
image.x-constraint: Pinned by digest: registry/name@sha256:<64 hex digits>.

sshContract.description: The contract the image implements. Only managed-ssh-v2 is supported.

uid.description: The user ID the worker runs as. Never root: 1 or higher.

gid.description: The group ID the worker runs as. Never root: 1 or higher.

resources.description: What each worker environment may use.

cpuMillis.description: CPU limit in millicores: 1000 is one core.

ephemeralGib.description: Limit in GiB for the worker's local scratch storage. It does not outlive the environment.

limits.description: How long environments live and how many an instance may have.

idleSeconds.description: How long an environment with no live lease may sit idle before it is retired.

maxLeaseSeconds.description: The longest a single lease on an environment may last. A lease never outlives it.

maxEnvironments.description: How many live environments of this backend one instance may have at the same time.

mounts.description: Mount slots by volume name. The assignment decides which volume fills each slot.

additionalProperties.description: One mount slot. The key is the volume's name.

mountPath.description: Absolute path where the volume appears in the worker. A volume shared with Hermes must use the same path as in the template.

readOnly.description: Mount the volume read-only in the worker.

optional.description: An optional slot is skipped when the assignment binds no volume to it. An unbound required slot makes the backend unusable for that instance.

registrySecret.description: The registry admin secret that holds the credentials to pull a private image.

name.x-constraint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter.
